first_song.title: Add a song you want to play
first_song.description: Keep track of songs you want to learn, are learning, or already know.
first_song.step1: Go to the Songs page and click this button:
first_song.step2: Type the artist and title of any song you'd love to play. Already in the library? Just pick the match. Not there yet? No problem — you're adding it:
first_song.step3: Tell the app where this song is on your journey. Later you can practice it section by section and watch your mastery grow:

reward.title: Draw your first guitar
reward.description: You played your first session — claim your Fame and open a case.
reward.body: That's exactly enough to open a case in the Arsenal. Claim it and you'll land there ready to pick your guitar.
